messages:
ria: FYI — PolarisWash dedicated rollout tonight 21:45 UTC. Quiet window 21:15	22:45. Customer wants 30m canary then slow ramp. Need infra/SRE/CS thumbs before I lock.

deploybot: Preflight link: https://go/runbooks/polariswash-dedicated-swap. Checks: capacity, certs, smoke, image, canary-suite.

omar (platform): Reserved pool allocated (pool PW-1), capacity OK. No infra ops during window.

kevin (sre): Rollback thresholds I suggest: error-rate >1.0% for 2m OR p95 latency >1s for 4m -> auto rollback. Also add healthcheck that fails on KV-cache mismatch. I'll monitor.

lucy (solutions): Customer requests cadence: 5% for 30m -> 20% for 20m -> 50% for 15m -> full. They also want a token-cost snapshot and latency diff at +1h.

matt-cs: I'll be on the customer channel and coordinate synthetic runs. Customer confirmation received.

deploybot: Preflight status: capacity=OK, certs=OK, smoke-tests=OK, image=available. Scheduling canary for 1769999100 (21:45 UTC).

ria: Ops command for reference:
```
rb deploy --team=polariswash --env=dedicated \\  --image=rwinference:v2026-06-02-rc1 \\  --canary=5%:30m,20%:20m,50%:15m --kv-cache=on
```

ria: Final go/no-go - :thumbsup: to proceed, :thumbsdown: to hold.

omar (platform): :thumbsup: infra green.

kevin (sre): :thumbsup: I'll be oncall.

lucy (solutions): :thumbsup: CS ready, will collect post-deploy report.

matt-cs: :thumbsup: customer ops on standby.

ria: Locking window and starting countdown. Deploybot will post live updates. If anyone needs to abort, flag here ASAP.
